full_chain_observation: WitherSkull extends the two actually-read native parents. AbstractHurtingProjectile.tick enters client or server-owner/chunk condition, calls Projectile.tick, queries ProjectileUtil, and only dispatches a non-MISS impact if the Forge impact hook does not cancel. Hook/query implementations not read.

Projectile.tick initializes hasBeenShot and tests leaving owner/root vehicle; parent canHitEntity first uses target.canBeHitByProjectile, then owner/leftOwner/shared-vehicle gate; AbstractHurtingProjectile further rejects noPhysics. This is local admission, not final target damage/control policy.

Projectile.onHit calls concrete onHitEntity then emits PROJECTILE_LAND at the hit location, or calls block.onProjectileHit then the block-position land event. Its native onHitEntity body is empty. No damage-success return is propagated by this dispatch.

Skull onHitEntity is server-only after super. Living owner selects witherSkull source8; true hurt then currently alive target requests enchantment damage effects, otherwise requests owner.heal5. Nonliving/missing owner instead selects magic5. Neither hurt=true nor !isAlive proves actual positive HP damage or this projectile causal kill; downstream bodies not read.

Only hurt=true plus living target enters difficulty choice: NORMAL10/HARD40 seconds, amplifier1 WITHER with effect source getOwner or projectile fallback. Easy/peaceful choose0 and no request. addEffect boolean is ignored; no explicit living-target still-alive gate before the request. Not an admitted-effect or immune-reason receipt.

Skull.onHit always continues after parent onHit returns; server requests power1 nonfire MOB explosion at current projectile x/y/z, then discard, independent of the local entity hurt bool. Hit point/event location and explosion current position must not be conflated. External exceptions/hooks/final explosion computation are outside read scope.

new_additional_nearest_complete_formal_o.concrete_observation: 拒晕是明确Applicable DENY，而不是血量是否变化；Temblor不检查addEffect成功且super.explodeHurt的push在hurt成功判断之外，拒晕不能推出无伤或纹丝不动。MobUtil.push按击退抗性缩放整个(原速度+增量)，并设置hasImpulse，非LivingKnockBackEvent，所以仅TANGLED的onKnockback取消不能证明此push被挡。拒晕分支无专门文字、微光、嗡声或限频；范围smash粒子/爆炸声不论单体是否拒晕都可发生。普通已中晕行为取消与拒晕是两个语义，不能把取消use包装各计一条。死亡清理包发ALL且仅实体ID，在另维度同ID可能误命中，客户端实体缺失直接丢，不含维度/UUID/代际。第三方stun兼容靠descriptionId.contains字符串，未证明实际格式命中。

Potion attribute-removal callback calls super then submits end sound BEFORE type-dispatched aftermath. Exact slave→fresh original-type actor spawn request then old drop-disable/death, no insertion transaction. Client convert may returnnull, so callback safety depends on native contract not established.
LivingUpdate effect presence requests xyz stateFX including slaves; attack refusal independently requests xyz ringFX regardless psychic hit success. Source-position floats and requested20/24/40 lifetimes are static presentation inputs, not measured visibility/lifetime. Random step loops can choose0; no deterministic finite iteration bound established.
